Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Yugal Kishore, Adv.
 Mr. Rupa Kumari, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Raj Ballabh Singh, APP

For O.P. No. 2 : Mr. Bachan Jee Ojha, Adv.
 ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 3 08-05-2025
Heard learned Counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
2. The petitioner apprehends her arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 720 of 2021 for the offence registered under sections 323, 341, 506, 420, 120B of IPC.
3. As per the prosecution story, the informant alleged that for a piece of land, Rs. 3,00,000/- was transferred to the petitioner but no such land was executed.
Upon demand, the abuse/threat of dire consequences which followed the case.

4. Learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that though through Google Pay, only Rs. 1,00,000 was paid, to show her bonafide, she is ready to return the amount alleged in the case (Rs.
3,00,000/-).
Learned counsel submits that the she is ready to pay the same in two installments of Rs. 1.5 lakhs each (totaling Rs. Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.88424 of 2024(3) dt.08-05-2025 3,00,000/-).
Further, if granted relief, she shall be handing over the first installment of Rs. 1.5 lakh by way of Demand Draft in the name of the complainant at the time of the execution of the bail bond.

sentences.text: Learned APP for the State, on the other hand, opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail submitting that the complainant was cheated of Rs. 3,00,000/- by the petitioner.

6. Considering the submissions of the parties as also the fact that the petitioner has shown her bonafide, is a lady, has no criminal antecedent, in that background, this Court is inclined to grant her the anticipatory bail with conditions subject to payment of Rs. 3,00,000/- as stated above.

The first installment of Rs. 1,50,000/- is to be paid at the time of execution of bail bond favouring Rajmohan Kumar and the second installment of Rs. 1,50,000/- shall be handed over to the complainant by 10 th of July, 2025.
7. Failure to do so, the prosecution is free to take immediate steps for the cancellation of her bail bond.

(Rajiv Roy, J) Vijay Singh/-
